label: TP
reason: Single java/xss alert verified as true positive. Data flow: Request Referer header (user-controlled) → param variable → URL decoded → passed to doSomething() → split(" ")[0] assigned to bar → returned → printed to response writer via toCharArray(). Resolved sink value at line 54 is the first token from the Referer header, which remains attacker-controlled throughout the chain. No HTML encoding occurs before writing to response. X-XSS-Protection header disabled further increases risk.

evidence.note: User-controlled Referer header flows through param variable, undergoes URL decoding, passes to doSomething(), splits on whitespace, and prints raw character array to response writer without HTML encoding
